fi-plectorhinchus-chaetodonoides.title: Harlequin Sweetlips
fi-plectorhinchus-chaetodonoides.summary: Juveniles are brown with large white, dark-edged dots. Grows large and needs a big tank.
rows: About 29 in; wild record 72 cm (28.3 in) TL (FishBase)
With caution. Eats small crustaceans, snails and worms
Carnivore. Can be hard to start; live feeder shrimp may be needed at first, then meaty foods
Indo_West Pacific: Maldives and Cocos Islands; Sumatra to Fiji and New Caledonia, north to Ryukyu Islands, south to Rowley Shoals
notes: Needs plenty of swimming room and hiding places.

fi-equetus-punctatus.title: Spotted Drum
fi-equetus-punctatus.summary: A striking Caribbean drum. Delicate and a slow eater, it often needs live food at first and is for experienced keepers.
rows: With caution: eats small shrimp, crabs and worms
Meaty live or frozen foods: live brine shrimp or mysis to start, then small shrimp and similar
Western Atlantic: Bermuda, Florida and the Bahamas to the Antilles
notes: Very sensitive to shipping; juveniles adapt best.
